description_html:
We are looking for energetic and friendly Hostess to join a vibrant rooftop restaurant in Malta. Be the first smile guests see and set the tone for a memorable dining experience.

The Role

  • Greet guests with warmth, personality, and professionalism
  • Manage reservations, waitlists, and seating efficiently
  • Guide guests to their tables and ensure smooth service flow
  • Provide information about the restaurant and answer guest inquiries
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming entrance area

Job Requirements

  • Previous experience in front-of-house or guest-facing roles
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in English; other languages are a plus
  • Friendly, approachable, and confident
  • Flexible and able to work different shifts as required
  • Team player with a positive, proactive attitude

Ready to welcome guests with a smile? Apply now!
